site_name: LONDON SOUTH EAST COLLEGES GREENWICH, 95 PLUMSTEAD ROAD, WOOLWICH, LONDON, SE18 7DQ
description: Description of Development: Demolition of existing buildings and construction of a mixed use, residential (Use Class C3), education (Use Class F.1) and commerical (Use Classes E/F.1/F.2) development  together with associated landscaping, play space, access, refuse and recycling storage, car and cycle parking, public realm improvements and associated works.Description for consultation purposes: Demolition of existing buildings and structures and construction of a 5-storey college (Use Class F.1) building of 5,486sqm (GIA) floorspace with student caf‚ and 6 blocks ranging from 5 to 13 storeys providing 294 residential dwellings (Use Class C3) and 325sqm (GIA) flexible non-residential floorspace (Use Classes E/F.1/F.2) together with associated landscaping, play space, access, refuse and recycling storage, car and cycle parking, public realm improvements and associated works.
